svg.text: Raised insulating module fixture — proposed dimensions
All dimensions mm. Nine carrier mounts; no module mounting-hole pattern used.
Actual-part support lands, headers, components, touch response and retention require fit checks.
Gray plate; blue bodies; pink keepers; green header service boxes; dark four-direction fences.
Details use local module coordinates. Corner tabs support the underside; open windows relieve components.
Retainers and tabs bear only on confirmed bare lands. No module drilled or solder joint used as a support.
F1..F9: 3.2 NPTH in carrier/plate, 8 diameter keepouts on both carrier faces; exact coordinates in CSV.
Pico/GPIO access remains open. Keep PM’s 26 x 26 touch-body copper/via exclusions. Fixture dimensions proposed.
Factory scope includes fixture metrology/machining, 24 keepers, 12 flexible harnesses, strain relief and inspection.
Require ≥2 mm measured component/wire clearance after tolerances and deflection. No physical fit/load test performed.
See MODULE_FIXTURE.md for fences, measured-thickness pedestals, hardware, assembly and acceptance targets.
